howto.what: 它会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进 src/channels/、注册到通道入口、安装固定版本依赖并跑构建与测试,让 NanoClaw 能通过邮件收发消息。Resend 账号、域名验证和密钥需你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件通道时触发;之后邮件以异步对话接入,你还要在 Resend 建账号、验证域名并配 webhook。

say.text: 我的邮箱是 you@example.com,把我设为 owner,再给我发封邮件
say.note: 会给你发一封 hello 邮件

say.text: 邮件发不出去,帮我排查 Resend 配置

howto.what_en: It copies the Resend email adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned dependency and runs build and tests so NanoClaw can handle email. Resend account, domain and keys remain manual.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Resend (email) channel to NanoClaw; email then joins as async conversations, and you still set up a Resend account, verify a domain and add a webhook.
